title: The Semester of Lake Minnow
author: Petra Underhill
blurb: Mirabel Nakamura, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before prom.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
